🚑 Quality checks and remaining work

  1. Resolve category uncertainty without discarding verified offers
    544 products still need category evidence. Their valid offers remain browsable under Needs category review; they are excluded from automatic meal matching.
  2. Recover source data before guessing from images
    7 products have no image-classifier row. Retailer product types, descriptions and explicit product forms take precedence over image guesses.
  3. Prefer source-backed rules over broad keyword guessing
    Use reliable source fields like Fresh Produce, retailer breadcrumbs, and product-detail metadata before adding keyword rules that can move drinks, supplements, or personal care into the wrong shelf.
  4. Use gold labels as training data
    Pick representative products from repeated failed brands and product families. One good label can help a whole cluster through the local text model.

retailer_description"Annie's Organic Vegan Mac Shells and Sweet Potato Pumpkin makes it easy to get a kid-approved side on the table in minutes. Ideal for the vegan pasta and sauce lovers in your household, each deliciously creamy serving is non-GMO and certified USDA Organic for the goodness you'd expect from Annie's. Reach for a warm, comforting portion as a convenient vegan snack, or a tasty part of lunch or dinner. Or serve some paired with vegan chicken nuggets or as a side dish to any meal. About two and a half servings per container. Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. Contains Annie's Organic Vegan Mac Shells and Sweet Potato Pumpkin, Pasta and Sauce, 6 oz; shelf-stable dried mix."

retailer_description"Annie's Frozen Uncured Pepperoni Mini Pizza Bagels combine delicious cheese, zesty tomato sauce and savory uncured pepperoni for a crunchy bagel snack! These mini pizza bagels are made with whole grains. Simply take some out of the freezer and put them in the oven, toaster oven, or microwave. retailer_description"Badger Zinc Oxide Face Sunscreen SPF 30 is a lightweight mineral sunblock designed to shield your skin without compromising on comfort or appearance. This facial sunscreen uses clear zinc oxide to ensure an effective barrier against harmful UV rays while leaving no white cast on your skin. Perfect for those seeking a face moisturizer with SPF, this vegan sunscreen combines powerful sun protection with a matte finish, making it ideal for daily use as a base under makeup. Our travel-sized 1.7 fl oz tube is the perfect companion for sunny getaways or daily commutes, ensuring that you have the best mineral face sunscreen wherever you go. Badgers Zinc Oxide Face Sunscreen is suitable for even the most delicate skin types. It’s an unscented formula free from harsh chemicals and fragrances. This SPF face moisturizer delivers deep hydration while offering strong defense against environmental stressors, a true dual-action sunscreen moisturizer. It seamlessly blends into all skin tones without any residue or greasiness common in other mineral sunscreens. Feel confident throughout your day at the beach or while running errands with our water-resistant facial sunscreen that stays put even when faced with sweat and water exposure. Our Face Mineral Sunscreen caters to those who need reliability and performance in their skincare products. Embrace this zinc oxide sunscreen for face-use and know that you have comprehensive sun care that's both protective and nourishing—a daily essential in facial sunscreens suited not only for protection but also as an outstanding facial moisturizer with SPF properties. Make Badgers Vegan Face Sun Screen your go-to product today and experience sustained protection coupled with nurturing care! retailer_description"Experience the perfect blend of cleansing and relaxation with Cleancult's Lemon Verbena Liquid Hand Soap Refill. Immerse your senses with calming scents while keeping your hands clean and refreshed. Embracing eco-consciousness, Cleancult offers an environmentally friendly hand soap refill solution. By opting for this 100% recycable paper-based refill, you get a high-quality vegan hand soap, and play a significant role in reducing plastic waste and promoting sustainability. Cleancult takes pride in its commitment to the environment. With our Liquid Hand Soap Refill, we are actively encouraging a zero-waste and greener lifestyle. By choosing this earth-friendly refill option, you help minimize the use of single-use plastic bottles, reducing your carbon footprint and contributing to a cleaner planet. Cleancult's plant-based hand soap formula is as gentle as it is effective. Infused with natural ingredients like aloe vera, this soap cleans hands without causing dryness, making it suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. The hand soap's soothing aromas provide tranquility as you cleanse, creating a refreshing and enjoyable experience. Experience the relaxing benefits of Cleancult's Liquid Hand Soap Refill and immerse yourself in delightful scents while knowing that you are actively participating in environmental preservation. Take a step towards a cleaner, greener lifestyle with Cleancult, your partner in promoting sustainability and protecting our planet for the future."

retailer_description"Think all bar soaps are created equal? Then let us change your mind with the All-One Hemp Citrus Orange Pure-Castile Bar Soap from Dr. Bronner’s. Unlike most bar soaps, this one is made with certified fair-trade ingredients and organic U.S.-grown hemp oil in order to provide a soft and luxurious lather that will not dry skin. It is 100% biodegradable and contains only all-natural, vegan ingredients that are environmentally-friendly, gentle and mild for safe and effective use on your face, body or hair. You can count on the bar soap to create a rich lather with every use while keeping skin smooth and soft, especially thanks to the inclusion of the purest certified organic oils. You’ll find it is completely free of any chelating agents, dyes, whiteners, synthetic fragrances, synthetic preservatives, thickeners or foaming agents. And we promise the bar soap smells just as good as it treats your skin and the environment, coming in a refreshing citrus medley of organic orange, lemon and lime oils. The All-One Hemp Citrus Orange Pure-Castile Bar Soap from Dr. Bronner’s comes in a five-ounce size and packaged in a 100% post-consumer recycled wrapper, and includes cruelty-free ingredients never tested on animals. You won’t find a better way to get clean!"

retailer_description"Badger Zinc Oxide Face Sunscreen SPF 30 is a lightweight mineral sunblock designed to shield your skin without compromising on comfort or appearance. Perfect for those seeking a face moisturizer with SPF, this vegan sunscreen combines powerful sun protection with a matte finish, making it ideal for daily use as a base under makeup. Our travel-sized 1.7 fl oz tube is the perfect companion for sunny getaways or daily commutes, ensuring that you have the best mineral face sunscreen wherever you go. Badgers Zinc Oxide Face Sunscreen is suitable for even the most delicate skin types. It’s an unscented formula free from harsh chemicals and fragrances. This SPF face moisturizer delivers deep hydration while offering strong defense against environmental stressors, a true dual-action sunscreen moisturizer. It seamlessly blends into all skin tones without any residue or greasiness common in other mineral sunscreens. Feel confident throughout your day at the beach or while running errands with our water-resistant facial sunscreen that stays put even when faced with sweat and water exposure. Our Face Mineral Sunscreen caters to those who need reliability and performance in their skincare products. Embrace this zinc oxide sunscreen for face-use and know that you have comprehensive sun care that's both protective and nourishing—a daily essential in facial sunscreens suited not only for protection but also as an outstanding facial moisturizer with SPF properties. Make Badgers Vegan Face Sun Screen your go-to product today and experience sustained protection coupled with nurturing care! retailer_description"Experience the perfect blend of cleansing and relaxation with Cleancult's Lemon Verbena Liquid Hand Soap Refill. Immerse your senses with calming scents while keeping your hands clean and refreshed. Embracing eco-consciousness, Cleancult offers an environmentally friendly hand soap refill solution. By opting for this 100% recycable paper-based refill, you get a high-quality vegan hand soap, and play a significant role in reducing plastic waste and promoting sustainability. Cleancult takes pride in its commitment to the environment. With our Liquid Hand Soap Refill, we are actively encouraging a zero-waste and greener lifestyle. By choosing this earth-friendly refill option, you help minimize the use of single-use plastic bottles, reducing your carbon footprint and contributing to a cleaner planet. Cleancult's plant-based hand soap formula is as gentle as it is effective. Infused with natural ingredients like aloe vera, this soap cleans hands without causing dryness, making it suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. The hand soap's soothing aromas provide tranquility as you cleanse, creating a refreshing and enjoyable experience. Experience the relaxing benefits of Cleancult's Liquid Hand Soap Refill and immerse yourself in delightful scents while knowing that you are actively participating in environmental preservation. Take a step towards a cleaner, greener lifestyle with Cleancult, your partner in promoting sustainability and protecting our planet for the future."

retailer_description"Think all bar soaps are created equal? Then let us change your mind with the All-One Hemp Citrus Orange Pure-Castile Bar Soap from Dr. Bronner’s. Unlike most bar soaps, this one is made with certified fair-trade ingredients and organic U.S.-grown hemp oil in order to provide a soft and luxurious lather that will not dry skin. It is 100% biodegradable and contains only all-natural, vegan ingredients that are environmentally-friendly, gentle and mild for safe and effective use on your face, body or hair. You can count on the bar soap to create a rich lather with every use while keeping skin smooth and soft, especially thanks to the inclusion of the purest certified organic oils. You’ll find it is completely free of any chelating agents, dyes, whiteners, synthetic fragrances, synthetic preservatives, thickeners or foaming agents. And we promise the bar soap smells just as good as it treats your skin and the environment, coming in a refreshing citrus medley of organic orange, lemon and lime oils. The All-One Hemp Citrus Orange Pure-Castile Bar Soap from Dr. Bronner’s comes in a five-ounce size and packaged in a 100% post-consumer recycled wrapper, and includes cruelty-free ingredients never tested on animals. You won’t find a better way to get clean!"

retailer_description"Annie's Frozen Uncured Pepperoni Mini Pizza Bagels combine delicious cheese, zesty tomato sauce and savory uncured pepperoni for a crunchy bagel snack! Enjoy bite-sized mini bagels made with cheese, organic flour, and tomatoes. This snack contains no artificial flavors or synthetic colors, and no nitrates or nitrites added*. These mini pizza bagels are made with whole grains. Simply take some out of the freezer and put them in the oven, toaster oven, or microwave. In just a few minutes, you'll have delicious bites that'll be a hit with the whole household! Perfect for busy families, they make a great snack, addition to lunch, or appetizers before dinner. You'll love how easy they are to heat and enjoy! Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. *Except those naturally occurring in cultured celery juice powder and sea salt. See nutrition information for sodium content."

retailer_description"Organic snacks you can bring on-the-go? Say hello to Annie's Chocolate Chip Chewy Granola Bars. Carefully crafted with non-GMO ingredients, these snack bars are made with no high-fructose corn syrup, so you can feel good about sharing them with the whole family. Best of all, Annie's Chocolate Chip Chewy Bars feature 8g of whole grain per serving. And like all Annie's granola bars, they're made with goodness. That means no artificial flavors or synthetic colors. Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit-flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. 8g whole grain per serving. At least 48g recommended daily."

retailer_description"Annie's Organic Honey Graham Crackers are a yummy organic snack for snackers of all ages. No artificial flavors or synthetic colors - just certified organic honey flavored crunches of yum. Try 'em plain, topped with nut butter, or in your favorite baking and s'more recipes. Add some joy and hoppiness to your day with Annie's - snacks made with goodness. Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit-flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. *10g whole grain per serving. At least 48g recommended daily."

retailer_description"Looking to reduce your plastic packaging use? Now you can refill your Shampoo & Wash bottle with our 32 oz Refill Pouch, which uses 80% less plastic than two 16 oz bottles! Make bath time fun with Sensitive Baby Fragrance-Free 2-in-1 Baby Shampoo & Wash. Created for babies and kiddos with sensitive skin, this mild cleanser is enriched with sustainably sourced nourishing shea butter and comes in a 30% post-consumer recycled refill pouch. Made with 23 plant-based ingredients such as oat, cocoa butter and aloe vera. Perfect for daily use even on the most delicate skin. This gentle formula is EWG Verified™ and fragrance free to ensure the highest level of safety and quality. Light and airy, this baby shampoo & wash rinses clean and leaves skin and hair feeling extra soft and moisturized. Our sustainably sourced Shea Butter supports village farmers in highlands of Guinea."

retailer_description"Experience ultimate skin nourishment and relief with Badger Organic Aloe Vera Gel for Face & Body, an ancient remedy renowned for its healing properties. Our aloe vera gel is not just certified fair trade but also designed to provide cooling, soothing comfort, making it the perfect after sun lotion for those hot summer days. Whether you're looking to soothe sunburn relief or simply maintain everyday skin vitality, this non-sticky aloe gel works like magic on your face and body. Hypoallergenic and unscented, its an ideal choice for those who value simplicity in beauty care without compromising effectiveness. Why is this 96% and not 100% pure aloe vera gel? Because 100 percent pure aloe gel would need to be refrigerated and would only last as long as fresh juice does. We use a few simple safe ingredient to preserve and stabilize our aloe. Any product claiming to be 100% aloe is misleading, unless it's literally a plant. Used as part of your daily routine or as critical after sun care, this vegan-friendly gel glides on smoothly without leaving any sticky residue behind. Convenience meets competence with Badger Organic Aloe Vera Gel ideal for both travelers and homebodies alike. Experience holistic skincare whether at home or away by incorporating our aloe vera lotion into your regimen today—it doubles as an excellent base under makeup or as a calming night cream replacement. Full Ingredient Lists: Organic Aloe , Xanthan Gum (from non-GMO corn), Water (and) Gluconic Acid (and) Sodium Benzoate (from cassia oil and natural fructose sources), Glyceryl Caprylate (from non-GMO plant material), Citric Acid (from non-GMO corn). = Certified Fair Trade. 96% of product."

retailer_description"Badger Zinc Oxide Face Sunscreen SPF 30 is a lightweight mineral sunblock designed to shield your skin without compromising on comfort or appearance. This facial sunscreen uses clear zinc oxide to ensure an effective barrier against harmful UV rays while leaving no white cast on your skin. Perfect for those seeking a face moisturizer with SPF, this vegan sunscreen combines powerful sun protection with a matte finish, making it ideal for daily use as a base under makeup. Our travel-sized 1.7 fl oz tube is the perfect companion for sunny getaways or daily commutes, ensuring that you have the best mineral face sunscreen wherever you go. Badgers Zinc Oxide Face Sunscreen is suitable for even the most delicate skin types. It’s an unscented formula free from harsh chemicals and fragrances. This SPF face moisturizer delivers deep hydration while offering strong defense against environmental stressors, a true dual-action sunscreen moisturizer. It seamlessly blends into all skin tones without any residue or greasiness common in other mineral sunscreens. Feel confident throughout your day at the beach or while running errands with our water-resistant facial sunscreen that stays put even when faced with sweat and water exposure. Our Face Mineral Sunscreen caters to those who need reliability and performance in their skincare products. Embrace this zinc oxide sunscreen for face-use and know that you have comprehensive sun care that's both protective and nourishing—a daily essential in facial sunscreens suited not only for protection but also as an outstanding facial moisturizer with SPF properties. Make Badgers Vegan Face Sun Screen your go-to product today and experience sustained protection coupled with nurturing care! retailer_description"Roll away the pain with Arnicare Roll-On by Boiron. This fragrance-free gel with cooling metal roller glides smoothly onto skin for a soothing massage experience precisely where you need it. The no-mess applicator, featuring a leak-free design, keeps hands clean and is easy to apply on the go. Powered by Arnica, the quickly absorbed formula delivers relief for muscle pain, stiffness, swelling from injuries, and bruises. Arnicare Roll-On does not contain menthol, camphor, methyl salicylate, or capsaicin, so there’s no traditional strong medicine smell. It’s also free of fragrances, dyes, and parabens. Arnicare Roll-On is available over the counter in a 1. 5 oz tube with metal roller. Also try Arnicare in cream and gel squeeze tubes and topical arthritis pain formula. *Claims based on traditional homeopathic practice, not accepted medical evidence. Not FDA evaluated."

retailer_description"Meet milky promise, your new everyday cleansing lotion that keeps things soft, simple, and seriously hydrating. This gentle cleansing milk removes impurities, makeup, and SPF without leaving skin tight or dry. Made with 97% naturally derived ingredients, it features squalane to soften and smooth while helping support the skin’s natural barrier, plus chamomile extract to calm and comfort dry skin. Think of it as your milky cleanser that doubles as self-care in a bottle. And here’s the proof: it boosts hydration by +24% after a single use*, with 100% of users noticing improvement*. Immediate comfort, no dryness, just clean, happy skin. This face cleansing milk works into a light lather to wash away dirt, oil, and even mascara, leaving skin clean and hydrated. Gentle enough for daily use, even for delicate skin types. EWG VERIFIED, vegan, and dermatologically tested, this milk cleanser for face is perfect for anyone who wants a minimalist routine with maximum comfort. Add this cleansing milk to your lineup and keep your skincare milky, clean, and happy. *Hydration test conducted on 11 volunteers, measurement taken after 1 hour."

retailer_description"Badger Zinc Oxide Face Sunscreen SPF 30 is a lightweight mineral sunblock designed to shield your skin without compromising on comfort or appearance. This facial sunscreen uses clear zinc oxide to ensure an effective barrier against harmful UV rays while leaving no white cast on your skin. Perfect for those seeking a face moisturizer with SPF, this vegan sunscreen combines powerful sun protection with a matte finish, making it ideal for daily use as a base under makeup. Our travel-sized 1.7 fl oz tube is the perfect companion for sunny getaways or daily commutes, ensuring that you have the best mineral face sunscreen wherever you go. Badgers Zinc Oxide Face Sunscreen is suitable for even the most delicate skin types. It’s an unscented formula free from harsh chemicals and fragrances. This SPF face moisturizer delivers deep hydration while offering strong defense against environmental stressors, a true dual-action sunscreen moisturizer. It seamlessly blends into all skin tones without any residue or greasiness common in other mineral sunscreens. Feel confident throughout your day at the beach or while running errands with our water-resistant facial sunscreen that stays put even when faced with sweat and water exposure. Our Face Mineral Sunscreen caters to those who need reliability and performance in their skincare products. Embrace this zinc oxide sunscreen for face-use and know that you have comprehensive sun care that's both protective and nourishing—a daily essential in facial sunscreens suited not only for protection but also as an outstanding facial moisturizer with SPF properties. Make Badgers Vegan Face Sun Screen your go-to product today and experience sustained protection coupled with nurturing care! retailer_description"Experience the perfect blend of cleansing and relaxation with Cleancult's Lemon Verbena Liquid Hand Soap Refill. By opting for this 100% recycable paper-based refill, you get a high-quality vegan hand soap, and play a significant role in reducing plastic waste and promoting sustainability. Cleancult takes pride in its commitment to the environment. With our Liquid Hand Soap Refill, we are actively encouraging a zero-waste and greener lifestyle. By choosing this earth-friendly refill option, you help minimize the use of single-use plastic bottles, reducing your carbon footprint and contributing to a cleaner planet. Cleancult's plant-based hand soap formula is as gentle as it is effective. Infused with natural ingredients like aloe vera, this soap cleans hands without causing dryness, making it suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. The hand soap's soothing aromas provide tranquility as you cleanse, creating a refreshing and enjoyable experience. Experience the relaxing benefits of Cleancult's Liquid Hand Soap Refill and immerse yourself in delightful scents while knowing that you are actively participating in environmental preservation. Take a step towards a cleaner, greener lifestyle with Cleancult, your partner in promoting sustainability and protecting our planet for the future."

retailer_description"Meet milky promise, your new everyday cleansing lotion that keeps things soft, simple, and seriously hydrating. This gentle cleansing milk removes impurities, makeup, and SPF without leaving skin tight or dry. Made with 97% naturally derived ingredients, it features squalane to soften and smooth while helping support the skin’s natural barrier, plus chamomile extract to calm and comfort dry skin. Think of it as your milky cleanser that doubles as self-care in a bottle. And here’s the proof: it boosts hydration by +24% after a single use*, with 100% of users noticing improvement*. Immediate comfort, no dryness, just clean, happy skin. This face cleansing milk works into a light lather to wash away dirt, oil, and even mascara, leaving skin clean and hydrated. Gentle enough for daily use, even for delicate skin types. EWG VERIFIED, vegan, and dermatologically tested, this milk cleanser for face is perfect for anyone who wants a minimalist routine with maximum comfort. Add this cleansing milk to your lineup and keep your skincare milky, clean, and happy. *Hydration test conducted on 11 volunteers, measurement taken after 1 hour."

retailer_description"Think all bar soaps are created equal? Then let us change your mind with the All-One Hemp Citrus Orange Pure-Castile Bar Soap from Dr. Bronner’s. Unlike most bar soaps, this one is made with certified fair-trade ingredients and organic U.S.-grown hemp oil in order to provide a soft and luxurious lather that will not dry skin. It is 100% biodegradable and contains only all-natural, vegan ingredients that are environmentally-friendly, gentle and mild for safe and effective use on your face, body or hair. You can count on the bar soap to create a rich lather with every use while keeping skin smooth and soft, especially thanks to the inclusion of the purest certified organic oils. You’ll find it is completely free of any chelating agents, dyes, whiteners, synthetic fragrances, synthetic preservatives, thickeners or foaming agents. And we promise the bar soap smells just as good as it treats your skin and the environment, coming in a refreshing citrus medley of organic orange, lemon and lime oils. The All-One Hemp Citrus Orange Pure-Castile Bar Soap from Dr. Bronner’s comes in a five-ounce size and packaged in a 100% post-consumer recycled wrapper, and includes cruelty-free ingredients never tested on animals. You won’t find a better way to get clean!"

retailer_description"GIOVANNI's 2chic Ultra-Moist Conditioner is powered by our Dual Moisture Complex of Avocado and Olive Oil that helps to add significant moisture, strength and shine for healthier and more lustrous locks that you can style with confidence. This ultra moisturizing Conditioner silkens coarse hair with softness and shine. Look in the Ingredients section for a listing of *USDA certified organic ingredients.GIOVANNI was the first full-range, salon-inspired hair-care brand in natural product stores, and today is the #1 selling Hair Care line in the United States Natural Products Industry. But before there was a brand, there was a pioneer. Arthur Guidotti had a vision and a love for all things hair. He began developing his passion as a hairstylist in Hollywood and Beverly Hills. He worked for a time with hairstylist icon Gene Shacove and was good friends with “the father of hair color,” Al Lapin . By the 1960s, Arthur was maturing his talents and decided to open his own salon, called On Sunset. The salon was a bustling site, on the famous Sunset Strip, and a hit with many Hollywood celebrities, including Lucille Ball . Since 1979 the GIOVANNI Rule of Balance has been our commitment to make each product as pure and as natural as possible without sacrificing exceptional product performance. GIOVANNI is committed to creating only the highest-performance formulations, wrapped in aesthetically beautiful packaging and marketed with extraordinary visuals and graphics."
